## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the release approval threshold before merge so releases that meet the configured minimum can proceed.

## Changes

The pull request regenerates the deployment catalog with production service names and ports, simplifies the service health check, and changes the release gate to use a strict approval comparison.

## Critical

- zzz-release/gate.py:5 — correctness — Accept releases at the approval minimum — With two approvals and the default minimum of two, `approved()` returns `False`. The `>` comparison contradicts “at least the configured number of approvals” in `zzz-release/gate.py:1`. — Releases that satisfy the approval requirement remain blocked until they receive an extra approval. — Fix: Restore `>=` and extend `test_approved_release` to cover approvals equal to the minimum.
